name: Modal
usage: Create and edit forms, confirmations, command palettes

props.name: open
props.description:
Whether the dialog is shown. The dialog does not close by itself: set `open` to false in `onOk` (after the
action has succeeded) and in `onCancel`. Keep the Modal rendered and switch `open`: a Modal that is rendered only
while it is open (`{show && <Modal open />}`) disappears at once when it closes, without its closing animation.

props.name: title
props.description: Title in the header. `null` removes the header; give the dialog an `aria-label` then.

props.name: children
props.description:
Content of the dialog, laid out with Stack / Section. It is unmounted after the dialog has closed. State
owned outside the dialog survives. If `Form.useForm()` lives outside Modal, clear it with `form.resetFields()`
while Form is still mounted, for example on cancellation or successful submission before closing.

props.name: onOk
props.description: Called when the OK button is clicked.

props.name: onCancel
props.description:
Called when the user dismisses the dialog: the Cancel button, the close button, `Esc`, or a click outside the
dialog (see `maskClosable`).

props.name: okText
props.description: Text of the OK button; the built-in text ("OK") by default.

props.name: okDisabled
props.description: Disables the OK button, for example until the required fields are filled in.

props.name: okLoading
props.description: Shows a loading indicator on the OK button and ignores clicks on it, while the action is running.

props.name: okTone
props.description: Semantic color of the OK button: `danger` for destructive actions such as removing or departing.

props.name: okTestId
props.description: Test hook of the OK button, rendered as its `data-testid`.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replaces the buttons at the bottom (Cancel and OK); `null` removes the footer.

props.name: closable
props.description: Shows the close button in the corner of the header.

props.name: maskClosable
props.description:
Clicking outside the dialog dismisses it (calls `onCancel`). Turn it off when the content must not be lost by
accident, such as a secret that is shown only once.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the dialog: a number in pixels or a CSS length such as `'min(420px, 92vw)'`.

props.name: flush
props.description:
Flush content: removes the padding of the dialog, so the content lays itself out and follows the rounded
corners (such as the search field and result list of a command palette). Usually combined with
`title={null}`, `footer={null}` and `closable={false}`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the dialog; needed when there is no `title`.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Put forms for creating and editing in a dialog; set `okLoading` while submitting.

examples.name: Flush
examples.title: Flush content
examples.description:
`flush` removes the padding of the dialog so that the content lays itself out and fits the rounded corners, like
the search box and result list of a command palette.
